card.name: Inside technetium and pertechnetate names
card.fires_on: The first pieces of the word technetium or pertechnetate (Techn, chn) in Tc 99m radiopharmaceutical labels. Also weakly on a few photographic-fixing terms such as Kodak products.

modes.label: Technetium word starts
modes.description: The opening piece of technetium or pertechnetate just before the 'etium' or 'etate' ending, in Tc 99m text.
modes.example: Do not use an eluate of the TECHNELITE ® ,<< Techn>>etium Tc 99m

modes.label: Photographic Kodak terms
modes.description: Punctuation or spacing inside Kodak photographic fixer and Photoflo product names.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the context, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires partway through the word technetium or pertechnetate in radioactive imaging kit labels.
